acceptance_criteria: cargo build --features sieve succeeds; cargo test --features sieve passes all integration tests including RFC examples from draft §2.3.1 and §2.4.1; cargo build (no features) still compiles cleanly
description: Implement the JMAP Sieve Scripts extension (draft-ietf-jmap-sieve-22) as a `sieve` feature flag in jmap-mail-server and jmap-mail-types. Gives JMAP clients ManageSieve-equivalent functionality (RFC 5804) over the standard JMAP API: create, read, activate/deactivate, validate, query, and destroy Sieve filter scripts stored server-side.
design: Types behind sieve feature in jmap-mail-types; handlers in src/sieve.rs behind sieve feature in jmap-mail-server. SieveBackend is a separate trait (not a supertrait of MailBackend) so consumers opt in independently. register_sieve_handlers<B: MailBackend + SieveBackend> is the entry point. VacationResponse compatibility (draft §4): backend returns forbidden SetError on destroy/content-update of VR-backed script.
title: jmap-sieve: JMAP Sieve Scripts in jmap-mail-server
